svg.title: ArduPilot RGB LED state table
svg.text: RGBLed.h (Copter-4.7.2): 10 steps of 100 ms, top to bottom is the order the conditions are checked
R red, B blue, G green, Y yellow, W white; dashed — off. On the right: the light over 1 s.
Rows 3–6 apply both armed and disarmed. Yellow 0.5 s — an emergency; two 0.2 s flashes — PreArm.
